propositions: Stateful fake transport masks failure modes (non-existent project keys parse-error vs return empty, inability to model multiple isolated projects), requiring live DC rehearsal against real JQL and issue creation
Per-project search without try/except in _build_snapshot causes entire pass to abort on non-existent project key instead of fail-closed per-project

Rehearsal must validate cross-project isolation by provisioning four throwaway scratch projects (P_ONE, P_TWO, P_ZERO, P_LEGACY) with random RBJ-prefixed keys and verify no outbound mutation targets leak between projects
Dry-run gating with bridge preview must enforce that previewed mutation set contains only targets in intended project before bridge sync executes any mutating scenario
Unknown or unconfigured project keys must trigger fail-closed behavior (pass errors, writes nothing) rather than silent empty result
Scratch project cleanup via DELETE /rest/api/2/project/{key} must run on all exit paths including mid-run failures, verified by 404 poll-until-success
